summary: Manual paper workspace fixture hygiene restored after BRAIN-025: the canonical fixture is baseline-only, generated run artifacts were removed from source state, and write/commit behavior is tested through temporary workspace copies.

hygiene_summary.canonical_fixture_mutation_removed: current_state.json is restored to baseline input state; generated run files and current_state.previous.json were removed from the canonical fixture.
hygiene_summary.write_run_temp_workspace_tested: --write-run writes expected artifacts only under a copied temporary workspace.
hygiene_summary.commit_state_temp_workspace_tested: --commit-state updates current_state.json and writes current_state.previous.json only under a copied temporary workspace.
hygiene_summary.collision_behavior_tested: Existing run_id collision returns code 2 with a clean FileExistsError-derived message.
hygiene_summary.default_read_only_preserved: Default JSON and --markdown commands write no run folder and do not mutate the canonical fixture file tree.

notes: No dispatcher, runtime wiring, prompt automation, live fetcher, network/API, credential, wallet, real order, or live trading behavior was added.
The existing --allow-identical-rerun flag was preserved and fixed so identical reruns succeed only when staged artifacts match after deterministic output-path normalization.
